integrity: The exact finite moments follow by combinatorial double counting; Gaussian convergence follows from an iid bottom-level approximation and a vanishing orthogonal high-level remainder. Reproducible finite tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to independent-copy, independently uniformly matched twisted hypercubes and simple four-cycles; asymptotic rather than finite exact normality; no assertion for dependent-copy duplicubes. Independent priority and independent validation have not been performed.
title: Exact four-cycle moments and Gaussian fluctuations in independently twisted hypercubes
